t: You are on Bow Lane, an alley in the City of London. The material here is thin, but it does name a resident. Philip Ford, who lived from 1631 to 1702, lived on this lane. He was a member of the Society of Friends, the Quakers, and the husband of Bridget Gosnell. Beyond that, I have no more detail, so I will leave you with a seventeenth-century Quaker's address.
